summary: WeRide Inc., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on September 4, 2026, solely to submit its Hong Kong Stock Exchange monthly return on movements in authorized and issued share capital for August 2026. The filing reports no changes in authorized share capital (4.5 billion Class A and 500 million Class B WVR ordinary shares) or issued shares, with treasury shares unchanged. It is a routine regulatory compliance disclosure, reflecting no corporate action, transaction, or special situation. The filing contains no deal terms, recommendations, or strategic developments; it only confirms public float compliance and capital structure stability for the month. No special-situation classification applies.
